claims: As of April 2026, WrestleMania 42 is not streaming on Peacock in the United States.
WWE Premium Live Events have moved to the ESPN App.
Peacock previously hosted WWE Premium Live Events.
WWE content, including major Premium Live Events, has moved to new platforms in 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is streaming exclusively on the ESPN App in the U.S.
Monday Night Raw is on Netflix.
International fans can watch WWE on Netflix
